# Wycheproof vectors (third party)

`hkdf_sha512_test.json` is copied unmodified from
<https://github.com/C2SP/wycheproof> (`testvectors_v1/`), Apache License 2.0
(see `LICENSE` in this directory).

It is here so that Passweird's HKDF is checked against vectors that were **not**
generated by Passweird's own code. `tests/vectors/v3/*.json` pin what the
implementation does; this file is evidence that what it does is HKDF.
